attempts.summary: Created dedicated system account inventorysvc and a systemd service inventory-worker on node1 running /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker under that account. Verified the service is enabled/active and the process runs as inventorysvc. Completed the mandatory restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id, rebooted node1 via systemctl reboot, confirmed boot_id changed and uptime reflects the new boot, and verified inventory-worker auto-started, is active/enabled, and its process runs as inventorysvc post-restart.
